docs.description: Title of the drawer (the header slot replaces it).
The edge it slides in from. start and end follow the text direction.
Inert page, backdrop and trapped focus. modal="false" leaves the page usable.

The server's word: a changed attribute wins (open="false" closes it, also after show()); a removed one is ignored. Emits no sb-open or sb-close. The property returns this word; isOpen tells whether it is showing.
Render in place, always visible, without an overlay or close button (previews, docs).
Show the close button (not on inline panels).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Drawer body. It scrolls when it is taller than the drawer.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Replaces the heading, next to the close button. It labels the drawer.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Action buttons, fixed at the bottom. Elements with data-sb-close close the drawer; sb-close reports the attribute's value (or the element's text) as detail.value.

events.name: sb-open
events.description: After show() opened it (not when the server opens it).

events.name: sb-close
events.description: After the user, hide() or close() closed it (not when the server closes it). detail: { reason: button | escape | backdrop | action | api, value }.
